seo.titulo: A Brand Kit for every client's clips | Clipfine
seo.descripcion: Each client's logo, colors and style saved in their Brand Kit and applied to every clip automatically. For agencies that handle many brands at once.

bajada: Each client's logo, colors and style are saved in their Brand Kit. Their clips come out with all of it applied, no matter who edits them.

d1.que: per client, kept apart from the rest

d2.que: per brand, taken from the logo or picked by hand

d3.que: for the logo, with size and opacity

agencia.logo: The client's logo always shows up in the same spot, without anyone having to remember it.
agencia.colores: Onboarding a new client takes a minute: upload the logo and their colors come out on their own.
agencia.estiloMarca: An editor picking up a new client doesn't have to learn their look. It's already saved.
agencia.aplicaSolo: No way to send a clip with another client's logo. Each brand only uses its own Brand Kit.

aplicaSolo.pie: Turned off for this clip only

p1.p: Can I keep each client's brand separate?
p1.r: Yes. Each client is a brand with its own logo, colors and style. One brand's clips never use another brand's Brand Kit.

p2.p: Who can change a client's colors?
p2.r: Only the brand's owner. The rest of the team edits clips with those colors but can't change the client's identity.

p3.p: What if a clip shouldn't carry the logo?
p3.r: Turn off the logo or change the style on that clip. The client's Brand Kit stays the same for every other clip.
